Steps in Character Creation

Choose an alignment, roll six ability scores in order, select a class that satisfies the prime requisite, then record hit points, armor class, saving throws, starting equipment and languages. Strength, Intelligence, Wisdom, Dexterity, Constitution and Charisma are scored from 3 to 18; the normal modifier is -3 at 3, -2 at 4-5, -1 at 6-8, none at 9-12, +1 at 13-15, +2 at 16-17 and +3 at 18. A prime requisite of 13 or better grants a 5% XP bonus; 9 or lower grants a 10% XP penalty.

Starting hit points are the maximum of the class hit die plus the Constitution adjustment; subsequent levels roll the hit die, with a minimum of 1 point. Starting gold is 3d6 x 10 gp. Characters begin with a languages score based on Intelligence and buy equipment from the Equipment chapter.
